author: Nintendo of America
description:
Rise to the occasion in FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE now on Nintendo Switch 2! A limited early purchase edition including FINAL FANTASY VII is available through Jan 31, 9pm PT: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/limited-early-purchase-editionfinal-fantasy-vii-remake-intergrade-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1057-01&utm_id=P1057-01 

"Together, we can do this. Sephiroth has to be stopped." 

The critically acclaimed FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE is the first game in the FINAL FANTASY VII remake trilogy. It retells the original story up to the escape from Midgar, with breathtaking visuals, fast-paced gameplay, and additional story elements. 

This RPG delivers unforgettable characters, a powerful narrative, and a hybrid battle system that blends real-time action with strategic, command-based combat. It also includes FF7R EPISODE INTERmission, a side story starring Yuffie Kisaragi that offers a fresh perspective running in parallel to Cloud’
title: FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE – Launch Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2

Play Woolhaven, the full-length expansion for Cult of the Lamb, now on Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/cult-of-the-lamb-woolhaven-70050000061749-switch/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1021-01&utm_id=P1021-01

A lost god calls you to a mysterious, sacred mountain. Rebuild the flock, explore all-new dungeons, and survive winter to discover the truth of the fallen lambs. New mechanics, new Followers, new secrets, and more await you in this massive expansion. Will you unearth the past, or will it consume you? The fate of Woolhaven rests in your hooves.

description:
Talking Flower launches March 12, 2026! Learn more: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/talking-flower-120835/?utm_source=SW-AAA&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=S1021-01&utm_id=S1021-01

From the Super Mario Bros. Wonder game, Talking Flower is blooming into the real world! This little guy talks about twice per hour, comments on the time and temperature, and can even play some familiar music. From the screen to your home, Talking Flower's here to brighten your day!

Pre-orders begin later today on My Nintendo Store and at select retailers nationwide.

author: Nintendo of America
description:
The #SuperMarioBrosWonder – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Meetup in Bellabel Park game launches March 26, 2026, only on the Nintendo Switch 2 system. Pre-orders are available now on Nintendo eShop: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/super-mario-bros-wonder-nintendo-switch-2-edition-plus-meetup-in-bellabel-park-switch-2/?utm_source=SW-AAA&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=S1021-01&utm_id=S1021-01

More content is coming to the Flower Kingdom in Super Mario Bros. Wonder – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Meetup in Bellabel Park! Team up with—or work against—family and friends in a variety of multiplayer attractions in Attraction Central, take on trainings from the Toad Brigade in Camp Central, or hop into the main game to track down treasure stolen by the Koopalings. Plus, Rosalina and her little friend, Luma, join in on the fun! Three amiibo figures from Super Mario Bros. Wonder will also be available.

title: Super Mario Bros. Wonder – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Meetup in Bellabel Park — What’s on the Way
